posts.cooked:
And to continue the collection:

Captain Cosmic: Your evil-doing days are numbered, no matter how dangerous you are! Have at them, allies!

Sky-Scraper: It is the time to be fighting! This is a thing I am not bad at. Very much the opposite.

 

Deadline: It is with great regret that I destroy your civilisation, humans. It is the only way.

Infinitor: The voices… the voices… cannot hear anything… must silence everything!

Infinitor, Heroic: I can barely resist the whispers of OblivAeon… You myst help me, heroes!

Kaargra Warfang: Come and fight for my pleasure! Are you worthy combatants? Find out! For glory!!!

Progeny: <No comments>

 

Infinitor vs Captain Cosmic:

  • Infinitor: Your face… so familiar… you must be the one the voices want me to end!
  • Cosmic: Brother! You know me! We must help you return to your right mind.

Heroic Infinitor vs Captain Cosmic:

  • Infinitor: My brother… I canot do this without you. Help me stop the inevitable!
  • Cosmic: You have my hand, Nigel. And the aid of my allies, as well.

Kaargra vs Sky-Scraper:

  • Kaargra: Welcome back, little one. Ready to return to your role as one of the Bloodsworn?
  • Sky-Scraper: You are not a friend person. I have new friend persons. We will not be staying a long amount of time.

 

I do like the Sky-Scraper ones a lot.
